title: MASTARS: Multi-Agent Sequential Trajectory Augmentation with Return-Conditioned Subgoals
abstract: arXiv:2611.17793v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The performance of offline Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is limited by the quality of the fixed offline dataset, motivating trajectory augmentation. However, augmenting multi-agent trajectories presents a fundamental challenge of the diversity-coordination trade-off: independent generation improves diversity but lacks coordination, while joint generation induces coordination but lacks diversity, reproducing the training distribution. To address this challenge in multi-agent data augmentation, we introduce MASTARS, a novel diffusion-based framework that generates multi-agent trajectories sequentially across agents while enforcing cross-agent consistent coordination via the method of inpainting. MASTARS produces trajectories that are diverse, coordinated and globally coherent. Experiments on various benchmarks such as MPE, SMAC, and SMAC-v2 demonstrate significant performance gains across multiple offline MARL methods.

translated_title: MASTARS：基于回报条件子目标的多智能体顺序轨迹增强
translated_abstract: 离线多智能体强化学习（MARL）的性能受限于固定离线数据集的质量，这促使了轨迹增强技术的发展。然而，多智能体轨迹增强面临一个根本性挑战，即多样性-协调性权衡：独立生成可以提升多样性但缺乏协调性，而联合生成能够带来协调性但缺乏多样性，只会复现训练分布。为了解决多智能体数据增强中的这一挑战，我们提出了MASTARS，一种新颖的基于扩散模型的框架，该框架按智能体顺序生成多智能体轨迹，同时通过修复（inpainting）方法强制实现跨智能体的一致协调。MASTARS生成的轨迹兼具多样性、协调性和全局一致性。在MPE、SMAC和SMAC-v2等多种基准测试上的实验表明，该框架在多种离线MARL方法上均带来了显著的性能提升。
tldr: MASTARS是一种基于扩散模型的多智能体轨迹增强框架，通过跨智能体顺序生成轨迹并利用修复方法保证协调一致性，有效解决了离线多智能体强化学习中多样性与协调性难以兼得的权衡难题。
en_tdlr: MASTARS is a novel diffusion-based framework that generates multi-agent trajectories sequentially across agents with inpainting-enforced coordination, resolving the fundamental diversity-coordination trade-off in offline MARL trajectory augmentation.
